newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 21.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 21.

text.p: These were the headlines on Estonian Kuku radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Former commander-in-chief of the Estonian defence forces, Aleksander Einseln, plans to appeal Tallinn city court's decision to dismiss his action against the security police.

- Eastern Virumaa county health authority discovered a batch of contaminated meat products that were marked with Valge meat processing plant labels. The plant said that the labels were forged and has sought police assistance.
- Tallinn city council decided on Thursday to privatise more municipal property and plans to raise 97 million kroons revenue.
